raw_label_semantics.ham: Binary non-spam in the TREC corpus; mailing-list origin. Candidate normal only.
raw_label_semantics.spam: Binary spam-trap mail in the TREC corpus. May mix commercial spam, scams and phishing.

individual_review_requirements: Review full subject and body locally
Record reviewer, manual method, UTC time and evidence
Verify original path, source, raw label and audited text fingerprint
Reject empty, missing body, decode-error and no-Chinese-character rows from eligibility
Keep duplicate/template groups and cross-source overlaps in review until joint resolution
Do not use ML or LLM predictions as ground truth
